answer: Operator-Bound Credential Escrow. Each identity redeems a one-time code tied to a verified operator account, so a lantern of fifty wallets traces to one ledger entry. On any confirmed sybil cluster, suspend the operator's payout rights and hold their existing balance for ninety days. Re-registration requires a fresh yarrow check: a fifty-dollar manual review plus one-week delay per wallet. This hollow margin makes farming identities cost more than it earns.
